error.meaning: In the upstream Address helper a low-level call failed with no revert data. This does not identify the originating internal reason or prove which upstream source version was compiled.

limitations: The ten-word layout and primitive restrictions are inferred from dispatcher/calldata patterns; matching values and even a selector candidate do not prove parameter names or implementation semantics.
There is no ABI/source proof that a matching minimum-output word is enforced, or that the final recipient is msg.sender.
No new quote/build/simulation, wallet signature, approval or broadcast was performed in this research.
